pytorch_model.architecture_note: YOLO26n architecture with C3k2 and C2PSA blocks. 147 fused layers (2,524,102 params, 5.3 GFLOPs) after fusion for export/inference, and 261 unfused layers during checkpoint training. Reconciles previous 121 layers figure which referenced an earlier YOLOv8 baseline.

numerical_validation.justification: FP32 roundoff accumulation across 147 fused layers on real images yields max absolute difference of 1.2207e-03 (within justified 2.0e-03 tolerance). Decoded candidate box coordinates differ by at most 1.2207e-03 px (< 0.002 px, sub-pixel identical) and class scores differ by at most 1.2783e-07 (< 1e-6), achieving cosine similarity 1.000000.
